evidence: Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC method signatures and output formatting across src/rpc/fees.cpp, src/rpc/mempool.cpp, and src/rpc/net.cpp.
rationale: Resolves a recurring downstream integration friction point and prevents sub-1 sat/vB rounding errors by supporting native sat/vB outputs. The PR description explicitly references issue #32093 noting that 'Returning feerates in BTC/kvB ... can be very burdensome and is not good practice, as the most widely adopted units are sat/vB.'
